Game Overview

Rainbow Monster Impostor Catcher is a action title where step into the shoes of Rainbow Blue and embark on a thrilling mission to capture elusive impostors. Navigate vibrant landscapes, strategize your approach, and outsmart mischievous foes in this exciting blend of action and puzzle-solving. With every level, the ticking clock heightens the adrenaline and challenge.
